allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files\\nodejs" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files \(x86\)\\nodejs" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem "$env:APPDATA\\npm" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5)

PowerShell($nodeDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\\AppData\\Local\\nodejs-portable"; $zipPath = "$env:TEMP\\node.zip"; Expand-Archive -Path $zipPath -DestinationPath $nodeDir -Force; $extracted = Get-ChildItem $nodeDir | Select-Object -First 1; $nodeBin = "$nodeDir\\$\($extracted.Name\)"; Write-Host "Node bin: $nodeBin"; & "$nodeBin\\node.exe" --version; & "$nodeBin\\npm.cmd" --version)
